rules.description: Do not use wrangler deploy command from this directory
rules.message: wrangler deploy should not be run from the project root. Deploy from the backend/ directory instead.

rules.description: For every step completed in the implementation plan, commit changes to GitHub
rules.message: After completing each implementation step, commit all changes to GitHub before proceeding to the next step.

rules.description: Do not use wrangler secret put command in this project
rules.message: wrangler secret put should not be used. Secrets are managed via environment variables and .env.example files per service.

rules.description: Never work with .env files, only use .env.example
rules.message: Do not create, read, or modify .env files. Only work with .env.example files. Copy .env.example to .env locally if needed, but .env files should never be committed or directly edited.
